task.pr_title: Add editor beatmap batch change support

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: It looks to me like `PostProcess` ought to be called after processing the batch inserts and deletes, right? Can't seem to find a way to break it, though...

evidence.thread_resolution: peppy: Ah, nice catch. I think this won't be visible in our current rulesets as we don't use this flow, but does need to happen that way around I believe.
